build_similarity_mask: build a similarity mask from descriptors and paired keypoint positions for SuperPoint descriptor loss computation
create_descriptor_loss: create a DescriptorLoss module that computes margin-based positive and negative pair losses on descriptor dot products
test_descriptor_loss_forward: test the DescriptorLoss forward method with descriptor tensors and a similarity mask
create_keypoint_loss: create a KeypointLoss class that inherits from torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss for keypoint classification
run_superpoint_losses: run SuperPoint descriptor and keypoint losses on paired image descriptors with correspondence masks
